title: Proxy bypassed for every host
description: .npmrc declares a `noproxy` value that bypasses the proxy for all hosts. Every registry request goes direct, so the inspection and caching the proxy provides are lost while the configuration still looks like it routes through one.
remediation: List only the internal hosts that must bypass the proxy.
limitation: It matches a `noproxy` value that bypasses the proxy for all hosts in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
